New York John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK)
San Juan Luis Munoz Marin International Airport (SJU)

While JetBlue is an attractive option for customers in the Northeast, its route network is quite minimal outside of the East Coast. Its network and schedules are not attractive to much of the country. In addition, JetBlue has also suffered major reliability challenges . This hurts its appeal to many potential customers, as operational reliability is a major factor in purchasing decisions. While BlueFirst won't solve all of JetBlue's issues, it should help the carrier with its network-wide revenue problem.

Not only do premium seats such as domestic first class have superior margins to economy seats, but premium demand is through the roof in the US. By not offering a domestic first-class product until now, JetBlue has essentially lost out on lucrative revenue, and several other low-cost carriers are now offering such a product. Frontier and Allegiant Air have both revealed domestic first class cabins to debut in 2027, while Breeze Airways already sells first class seats.
body_zh: Daniel 带着以商业为中心的方式进入航空界，加入了 Simple Flying。丹尼尔喜欢分析战略以及公司如何相互竞争以取得领先一步。除了战略之外，丹尼尔还对飞机设计和航空历史充满热情。
捷蓝航空正在发生变化。该航空公司最近提高了经济舱乘客的行李费；截至 11 月 3 日，第一件托运行李的费用为 50 至 70 美元，具体取决于日期和预订机票的时间，而第二件托运行李的费用为 70 至 85 美元。这些价格很高，明显高于美国传统航空公司规定的托运行李费用，而捷蓝航空在可选附加服务之前的基本票价往往低于竞争对手。
与此同时，捷蓝航空即将推出“BlueFirst”国内头等舱，并将在全机队推广。该航空公司将于 12 月 8 日在从波士顿飞往劳德代尔堡的航线上首次推出该客舱，然后在整个网络中引入该客舱。虽然捷蓝航空对所有票价进行动态定价，但在首次推出客舱时，BlueFirst 单程票价将从 249 美元起，虽然这当然并不意味着所有机票都将以这种方式定价，但与该航空公司的经济舱相比，这些票价将非常有吸引力。

捷蓝航空为其 Main、EvenMore、BlueFirst 和 Mint 舱等提供三种票价类型：Base、Standard 和 Flex。 Main 和 EvenMore 的票价均不包含托运行李，这意味着想要托运行李的乘客需要在机票总价的基础上添加至少 50 美元。与此同时，该航空公司的新 BlueFirst 票价确实包含至少一件托运行李，而 BlueFirst Flex 票价则包含两件托运行李。尤其值得注意的是 BlueFirst 的票价实际上相当有吸引力。
该航空公司从波士顿到劳德代尔堡的单程 BlueFirst 票价起价为 299 美元，随后不久又开通了拉瓜迪亚机场和劳德代尔堡之间的航线，起价为 249 美元。尽管大多数机票的售价要高得多，但该航空公司的 BlueFirst 票价基本上比同等主要机票高出约 40% 至 70%。
但最重要的是，即使是 BlueFirst Base 机票也包含托运行李，稍微缩小了差距。 BlueFirst Flex 包含两件托运行李，而 Main Flex 或 EvenMore Flex 票价则不包含两件托运行李。虽然 BlueFirst 门票的全部费用仍然较高，但已经比预期接近了。
随着近期行李费的上涨，BlueFirst 机票对于那些会托运行李并愿意支付更多费用以获得更好体验的乘客来说确实颇具吸引力。 BlueFirst 提供加大腿部空间的大躺椅，以及免费餐点和优质饮料。毫无疑问，它提供了比主设备更舒适的体验，而且一旦考虑到辅助设备，价格差异也不是特别大。更重要的是，捷蓝航空对 BlueFirst 的初始定价并不遵循美国的标准做法。
一般来说，美国的传统航空公司（即提供国内头等舱时间最长的航空公司）的头等舱机票价格不会比经济舱高40%至70%。国内头等舱票价通常比经济舱票价贵得多，即使考虑到辅助设施，头等舱的价格也确实存在溢价。诚然，捷蓝航空最初的 BlueFirst 机票是在竞争激烈的佛罗里达市场销售的，那里的票价往往较低，但它们在价格上仍然大大低于传统航空公司。
对此的一种看法是捷蓝航空深思熟虑的策略。该航空公司此前从未提供过国内头等舱，并计划在整个网络中快速推出 BlueFirst。不仅需要让潜在客户了解并接触该产品，航空公司还需要将客户从美国航空、达美航空和联合航空中吸引过来。具有吸引力的初始票价有助于宣传，同时增加预订量，从而提高知名度。
然而，另一方面，航空公司通常收取他们认为客户愿意支付的最高价格。捷蓝航空在价格上低于竞争对手也可以被视为该航空公司定价能力的体现，这并不是一个积极的信号。捷蓝航空推出 BlueFirst 的原因之一是增加收入，因为头等舱的票价通常较高。如果它继续在整个系统的价格上低于竞争对手，那么这将成为一个问题。
捷蓝航空的运营方式类似于廉价航空公司，例如边疆航空 (Frontier) 或忠诚航空 (Allegiant Air)。然而，该航空公司的差异化不一定是通过低廉的票价，而是通过乘客的体验。在国内航班上普及之前，该航空公司在经济舱中提供了更大的腿部空间以及座椅靠背屏幕。此外，零食选择多样，该航空公司后来在横贯大陆和跨大西洋航线上推出的Mint商务舱也广受好评。
尽管采用低成本航空公司的结构，该航空公司仍提供与传统航空公司类似的乘客体验，并且在某些方面可以说更好。然而，捷蓝航空一直无法因其出色的经济舱产品而获得票价溢价，而其东北部业务的运营成本也很高。此外，该航空公司过去没有提供头等舱，这进一步限制了收入，并且该航空公司在扩大客户群方面面临着严峻的挑战。
劳德代尔堡好莱坞国际机场 (FLL)
纽约约翰·F·肯尼迪国际机场 (JFK)
圣胡安·路易斯·穆尼奥斯·马林国际机场 (SJU)
虽然捷蓝航空对于东北部的客户来说是一个有吸引力的选择，但其在东海岸以外的航线网络却相当有限。它的网络和时刻表对该国大部分地区没有吸引力。此外，捷蓝航空还遭遇了重大的可靠性挑战。这损害了它对许多潜在客户的吸引力，因为操作可靠性是购买决策的主要因素。虽然 BlueFirst 无法解决捷蓝航空的所有问题，但它应该可以帮助该航空公司解决整个网络的收入问题。
不仅国内头等舱等高级座位的利润率高于经济舱座位，而且美国的高级座位需求也非常高。由于迄今为止尚未提供国内头等舱产品，捷蓝航空基本上失去了丰厚的收入，而其他几家低成本航空公司现在也提供此类产品。边疆航空 (Frontier) 和忠诚航空 (Allegiant Air) 均已透露将于 2027 年推出国内头等舱，而微风航空 (Breeze Airways) 已开始销售头等舱座位。

title_en: Here's What Pilots First Notice When Switching From The Boeing 737 MAX To The Airbus A320neo
title_zh: 以下是飞行员从波音 737 MAX 切换到空客 A320neo 时首先注意到的内容
summary: Stepping into the cockpit of an Airbus A320neo after flying the Boeing 737 MAX reveals a world of differences.
summary_zh: 驾驶完波音 737 MAX 后，踏入空客 A320neo 的驾驶舱，发现了一个截然不同的世界。
body_en: Josh is an avgeek and pilot based in the United Kingdom. He started at Simple Flying as a Commercial Aviation Journalist before taking a less writing-focused role as Content & Growth Lead for Simple Flying's Flight Tracker.

Stepping from the cockpit of the Boeing 737 MAX into that of the Airbus A320neo is not just a change of aircraft: it represents a transition between two fundamentally different eras and philosophies of aviation design. Although both aircraft entered service in the 21st century - the A320neo in 2016 and the 737 MAX in 2017 - their underlying DNA reflects very different starting points.

The A320 family was originally conceived in the 1980s as the world’s first fully digital fly-by-wire narrow-body airliner. At the same time, the 737 traces its origins back to 1965, making it one of the longest continuously produced commercial aircraft families in history. For pilots, these differences are not abstract: they are immediately tangible.

The 737 MAX typically cruises at around Mach 0.79 with a range of roughly 3,550 nautical miles (6,575 km) for the MAX 8. In contrast, the A320neo cruises at about Mach 0.78 with a comparable range of around 3,400–3,700 nautical miles (6,300–6,850 km) depending on configuration.

Both aircraft carry between 150 and 180 passengers in standard layouts, yet the experience of flying them differs dramatically. From cockpit ergonomics and control inputs to automation philosophy and system integration, transitioning pilots must adjust not just their procedures, but their instincts and expectations about how the aircraft behaves.

One of the most immediately noticeable differences lies in cockpit space and layout. The A320neo’s cockpit width is approximately 12 feet and one inch (3.7 meters), benefiting from a wider fuselage cross-section designed specifically for digital avionics and side-mounted controls. This results in more shoulder room, larger instrument panels, and a generally less cramped working environment.

By comparison, the 737 MAX cockpit retains a narrower fuselage cross-section of about 11 feet and seven inches (3.54 meters). While Boeing has modernized the cockpit with four large-format displays, measuring around 15.1 inches (38.4 cm) diagonally on newer variants, the physical space between pilots remains tighter. This is particularly noticeable during long-duty days and high-frequency short-haul operations.

The difference in design philosophy becomes evident in panel layout as well. Airbus uses a more centralized, screen-focused interface with six primary LCDs, while Boeing’s layout reflects incremental upgrades layered onto an older architecture. For pilots, this translates into differences in scan patterns, situational awareness, and even fatigue levels over time.

The control interface is perhaps the most iconic distinction between these jets . The 737 MAX uses a conventional control yoke, mechanically linked (via cables and pulleys, with hydraulic assistance) to the control surfaces. This system provides force feedback, allowing pilots to feel aerodynamic loads and resistance, which many describe as intuitive.

The A320neo, by contrast, uses a sidestick controller with a maximum deflection of about 16 degrees laterally and 20 degrees longitudinally. Instead of moving control surfaces directly, the sidestick sends electrical signals to flight control computers, which interpret and execute commands.

A critical difference is that Airbus sidesticks are not mechanically linked. This means one pilot cannot physically feel the other’s input. Instead, priority is controlled electronically, with override logic and warning tones. For pilots used to the 737, this lack of tactile cross-feedback can be one of the most challenging adjustments early in training.

The Airbus A320neo uses a fully digital fly-by-wire control system in which pilot inputs are converted into electrical signals and sent to a network of flight control computers. These computers, arranged in multiple redundant channels, interpret the input and command hydraulic actuators at the control surfaces.

The aircraft has three independent hydraulic systems (Green, Blue, and Yellow), each operating at around 3,000 psi (20.7 MPa), which power the ailerons, elevators, rudder, and other flight controls. Rather than moving surfaces directly, the pilot’s input is processed, filtered, and then executed by the system, ensuring smooth, coordinated control movements even in turbulent or high-workload conditions.

Meanwhile, the Boeing 737 MAX retains a more traditional control architecture. Pilot inputs are transmitted mechanically through cables, pulleys, and linkages, and then assisted by hydraulic power control units to move the control surfaces. The aircraft uses dual main hydraulic systems (System A and System B), also operating at approximately 3,000 psi (20.7 MPa), to provide the force needed to move primary flight controls.

Because of this direct linkage, there is a continuous physical relationship between pilot input and surface movement, even though hydraulic pressure does most of the heavy lifting. These underlying systems create fundamentally different control behaviors.

In the Airbus A320neo, the computers act as intermediaries, continuously adjusting and optimizing control surface movements based on pilot input and aircraft state, which results in smoother and more standardized responses. In the Boeing 737 MAX, the pilot’s input is more directly transmitted, with hydraulics simply amplifying the force required, leading to a more immediate and tactile connection between the controls and the aircraft’s motion.

Airbus and Boeing diverge most clearly in how automation governs the aircraft at the edges of the flight envelope. In the A320neo, this is defined through a hierarchy of control laws. Normal Law provides full flight envelope protection, preventing stalls, overspeeds, and excessive bank or pitch.

If certain failures occur, the system degrades into Alternate Law, where some protections, such as stall protection, are reduced or replaced with warnings. In more severe cases, it reverts to Direct Law, where pilot inputs correspond much more closely to control surface movement, with minimal computer intervention.

This layered approach ensures the aircraft remains controllable in all situations, while progressively handing more responsibility back to the pilot as system capability decreases. In the 737 MAX, however, there is no equivalent system of 'laws.' The aircraft maintains a consistent control philosophy regardless of failures, with pilots retaining direct authority throughout.

Protections exist in the form of alerts and augmentation systems, such as a stick shaker for stall warning or speed trim for stability, but these do not impose hard limits on pilot input. Even in abnormal conditions, the relationship between pilot command and aircraft response remains largely unchanged.
body_zh: 乔什是一位来自英国的普通极客和飞行员。他最初在 Simple Flying 担任商业航空记者，后来担任 Simple Flying 的 Flight Tracker 的内容和增长主管，担任不太注重写作的角色。
从波音 737 MAX 的驾驶舱进入空客 A320neo 的驾驶舱不仅仅是飞机的变化：它代表了两个根本不同的时代和航空设计理念之间的过渡。尽管这两架飞机均于 21 世纪投入使用（A320neo 于 2016 年投入使用，737 MAX 于 2017 年投入使用），但它们的基本 DNA 反映了截然不同的起点。
A320 系列最初构想于 20 世纪 80 年代，是世界上第一架全数字电传窄体客机。同时，737 的起源可以追溯到 1965 年，使其成为历史上连续生产时间最长的商用飞机家族之一。对于飞行员来说，这些差异并不是抽象的：它们是直接有形的。
737 MAX 通常以 0.79 马赫左右的速度巡航，MAX 8 的航程约为 3,550 海里（6,575 公里）。相比之下，A320neo 的巡航速度约为 0.78 马赫，根据配置，航程约为 3,400–3,700 海里（6,300–6,850 公里）。
两架飞机均采用标准布局，可搭载 150 至 180 名乘客，但飞行体验却截然不同。从驾驶舱人体工程学和控制输入到自动化原理和系统集成，过渡飞行员不仅必须调整他们的程序，还要调整他们对飞机行为的本能和期望。
最明显的差异之一在于驾驶舱空间和布局。 A320neo 的驾驶舱宽度约为 12 英尺 1 英寸（3.7 米），得益于专为数字航空电子设备和侧面安装控制装置设计的更宽的机身横截面。这会带来更多的肩部空间、更大的仪表板以及总体上不那么拥挤的工作环境。
相比之下，737 MAX 驾驶舱保留了约 11 英尺 7 英寸（3.54 米）的较窄机身横截面。虽然波音公司对驾驶舱进行了现代化改造，配备了四个大型显示器，较新型号的对角线尺寸约为 15.1 英寸（38.4 厘米），但飞行员之间的物理空间仍然更加紧张。这在长时间工作和高频次短途运营期间尤其明显。
设计理念的差异在面板布局上也变得明显。空中客车公司使用更集中、以屏幕为中心的界面，带有六个主要液晶显示屏，而波音公司的布局则反映了在旧架构上分层的增量升级。对于飞行员来说，随着时间的推移，这会转化为扫描模式、态势感知甚至疲劳程度的差异。
控制界面也许是这些喷气式飞机之间最具标志性的区别。 737 MAX 使用传统的控制轭，通过机械方式（通过电缆和滑轮，借助液压辅助）连接到控制表面。该系统提供力反馈，使飞行员能够感受到空气动力载荷和阻力，许多人认为这是直观的。
相比之下，A320neo 使用侧杆控制器，最大横向偏转约为 16 度，纵向最大偏转为 20 度。侧杆不是直接移动控制面，而是向飞行控制计算机发送电信号，由飞行控制计算机解释和执行命令。
一个关键的区别是空中客车公司的侧杆不是机械连接的。这意味着一名飞行员无法实际感受到另一名飞行员的输入。相反，优先级是通过电子方式控制的，具有超控逻辑和警告音。对于习惯 737 的飞行员来说，缺乏触觉交叉反馈可能是训练早期最具挑战性的调整之一。
空客 A320neo 使用全数字电传操纵系统，飞行员的输入被转换为电信号并发送到飞行控制计算机网络。这些计算机排列在多个冗余通道中，解释控制面上的输入和命令液压执行器。
该飞机拥有三个独立的液压系统（绿色、蓝色和黄色），每个系统的工作压力约为 3,000 psi（20.7 MPa），为副翼、升降舵、方向舵和其他飞行控制装置提供动力。飞行员的输入不是直接移动表面，而是由系统进行处理、过滤和执行，即使在湍流或高工作负载条件下也能确保平稳、协调的控制运动。
同时，波音 737 MAX 保留了更传统的控制架构。飞行员输入通过电缆、滑轮和连杆机械传输，然后在液压动力控制单元的辅助下移动控制面。该飞机使用双主液压系统（系统 A 和系统 B），也在约 3,000 psi（20.7 MPa）的压力下运行，以提供移动主要飞行控制装置所需的力。
由于这种直接联系，飞行员输入和地面运动之间存在连续的物理关系，尽管液压承担了大部分繁重的工作。这些底层系统创建了根本不同的控制行为。
在空客 A320neo 中，计算机充当中介，根据飞行员输入和飞机状态不断调整和优化控制面运动，从而实现更平稳、更标准化的响应。在波音 737 MAX 中，飞行员的输入可以更直接地传输，液压系统只是放大所需的力，从而在控制装置和飞机运动之间实现更直接、更触觉的连接。
空客和波音在自动化如何控制飞行包线边缘的飞机方面存在最明显的分歧。在 A320neo 中，这是通过控制法则的层次结构来定义的。正常法则提供完整的飞行包线保护，防止失速、超速以及过度倾斜或俯仰。
如果发生某些故障，系统会降级为替代法则，其中一些保护（例如失速保护）会减少或被警告取代。在更严重的情况下，它会恢复到直接法则，其中飞行员的输入更紧密地对应于控制表面运动，而计算机干预最少。
这种分层方法确保飞机在所有情况下都保持可控，同时随着系统能力的下降，逐渐将更多责任交还给飞行员。然而，在 737 MAX 中，没有等效的“法律”系统。无论出现故障，飞机都保持一致的控制理念，飞行员始终保留直接权力。
保护措施以警报和增强系统的形式存在，例如用于失速警告的摇杆器或用于稳定性的速度调整，但这些不会对飞行员的输入施加硬性限制。即使在异常情况下，飞行员指挥和飞机响应之间的关系也基本保持不变。

title_en: Traveler Says American Pilots Should Have Just “Had A Cup Of Coffee” Instead Of Following Federal Law
title_zh: 旅行者称美国飞行员应该“喝杯咖啡”而不是遵守联邦法律

body_en: There’s no denying that traveling by air can be stressful, and that it’s extremely frustrating when things go wrong. Furthermore, not everyone is a frequent traveler, and understands the ins and outs of how the airline industry functions.

So that brings us to a complaint from last night from an American Airlines passenger. The complaint is so incredibly off base in the first place. But what’s even worse is that when this person is confronted with reality, he just doubles down and keeps going. This person deserves to be roasted, and if you ask me, should be banned from the airline.
Traveler whines about flight cancelation following accident
Late last night, a social media user posted a picture of two airline pilots on X, with the following caption
I won’t be seeing my family this Thanksgiving because a couple pilots couldn’t drink a cup of coffee and get us home. They clocked out in two hours, but we had 3 hr flight. Thanks @AmericanAir
John Smith (@smith_john50997) November 26, 2026

I can totally appreciate how frustrating it is when a flight is canceled, but this is actually very simple — federal regulations dictate the maximum number of hours that pilots can fly, and that’s for good reason. The airline industry operates with the goal of putting safety above all else, and pilot fatigue has been a contributing factor to many accidents over the years.

I totally get it, you want to be home for Thanksgiving, and it sucks things went wrong, but those are the facts. This is federal law, and on top of that, we should want pilots to be well rested, rather than just saying “keep working, just have another cup of coffee.”

I’d like to point out what makes this even worse — this was a flight out of Miami last night, and the airport had shut down due to a ground stop, because a FedEx MD-11 ran off the runway . That was an absolute pain for all passengers out of the airport, and I can assure you that American also wasn’t happy about that happening, and the impact it had on its operations.
Even after endless roasting, the traveler doubles down

All would be forgiven if this traveler either just didn’t say anything further, or acknowledged “ah, I wasn’t aware of that.” Instead, he has had dozens and dozens of posts, just going on and on and on.
He posted about how American claimed the cancelation was the airport’s fault, but insisted “it’s actually these pilots fault,” and suggested “pilots will lie to save money for their company.”
@AmericanAir will cancel your flight the day before Thanksgiving and say it's the airports fault. It's actually these pilots fault. pic.twitter.com/v4t8KPSojR
@AmericanAir pilots will lie to save money for their company @AmericanAir pic.twitter.com/7VmOKILwCL

He then attacked American’s rebooking lines at Miami Airport. Look, I’ll be the first to call out American when they fall short (and they often do!), but if you really can’t figure out why rebooking lines “wrap around the corner” on one of the busiest travel days of the year when there was an accident that shut down an airport, then you really aren’t trying very hard to understand things.
@AmericanAir why do your rebooking lines always wrap around the corner? How bad are your operations? pic.twitter.com/Id8AaTiom1
body_zh: 不可否认，乘飞机旅行可能会带来压力，而且当出现问题时会非常令人沮丧。此外，并不是每个人都是经常旅行的人，并且了解航空业运作的来龙去脉。
这让我们想起昨晚一位美国航空乘客的投诉。这种抱怨首先就令人难以置信。但更糟糕的是，当这个人面对现实时，他只是加倍努力，继续前进。这种人活该被骂，如果你问我的话，应该禁止他乘坐航空公司。
旅客抱怨事故后航班取消
昨晚深夜，一名社交媒体用户在 X 上发布了两名航空公司飞行员的照片，并配上以下标题
今年感恩节我不会见到我的家人，因为几个飞行员无法喝一杯咖啡送我们回家。他们在两个小时内下班，但我们有 3 小时的飞行。谢谢@美国航空
约翰·史密斯 (@smith_john50997) 2026 年 11 月 26 日
我完全理解航班被取消时是多么令人沮丧，但这实际上非常简单——联邦法规规定了飞行员可以飞行的最大小时数，这是有充分理由的。航空业的运营目标是安全高于一切，多年来飞行员疲劳一直是导致许多事故的一个因素。
我完全明白，你想回家过感恩节，出了问题很糟糕，但这些都是事实。这是联邦法律，最重要的是，我们应该希望飞行员充分休息，而不是只是说“继续工作，再喝一杯咖啡”。
我想指出是什么让事情变得更糟——这是昨晚从迈阿密起飞的航班，机场因地面停留而关闭，因为一架联邦快递 MD-11 冲出了跑道。这对所有离开机场的乘客来说都是绝对的痛苦，我可以向你保证，美国航空也对这种情况及其对其运营的影响感到不高兴。
即使经过无尽的烘烤，旅行者也会加倍努力
如果这位旅行者不再多说什么，或者承认“啊，我不知道这一点”，那么一切都可以原谅。相反，他已经发了几十个帖子，一直在不断地继续。
他发帖称，美国航空声称航班取消是机场的错，但坚称“这实际上是这些飞行员​​的错”，并暗示“飞行员会撒谎为公司省钱。”
@AmericanAir 将在感恩节前一天取消您的航班，并说这是机场的错。这实际上是这些飞行员​​的错。 pic.twitter.com/v4t8KPSojR
@AmericanAir 飞行员会撒谎为他们的公司省钱 @AmericanAir pic.twitter.com/7VmOKILwCL
然后他攻击了美国航空在迈阿密机场的改签线路。听着，当美国航空达不到要求时，我将是第一个指出他们的问题的人（他们经常这样做！），但如果你真的不明白为什么在一年中最繁忙的旅行日之一、发生了导致机场关闭的事故时，重新预订线路“即将到来”，那么你就真的没有努力去理解事情。
@AmericanAir 为什么你们的重新预订线路总是在拐角处缠绕？你们的运营有多糟糕？ pic.twitter.com/Id8AaTiom1

title_en: Air France Economy Class: Impressions From A Flight Across The Atlantic
title_zh: 法航经济舱：飞越大西洋的印象
summary: A look at Air France economy on a quick Brazil–Ireland round trip via Paris, covering the seat, meals, entertainment tech, crew, and a busy CDG transit.
summary_zh: 法国航空经巴黎往返巴西至爱尔兰的经济舱，包括座位、餐食、娱乐技术、机组人员以及繁忙的戴高乐机场转机
body_en: In the spirit of trying out new ideas and topics here at OMAAT, and having learned that many of you are interested in reading about economy, here are some thoughts about how well Air France does the job.

I’ll focus on the daytime return flight from Dublin (DUB) back to Rio (GIG) via Paris (CDG), as I slept through as much of the outbound overnight as I could. This is not a full review — rather, it’s some general comments on the seats, food, and tech, in Air France’s economy offering.
After completing this trip, I’ve flown back and forth between Brazil and France in all four of Air France’s cabin classes. Yes, including La Première – I do fly in the pointy end sometimes. 😉
First: Some observations from the transit experience at the infamous CDG
Having transited through Paris Charles de Gaulle so many times now, I’m actually starting to learn my way around the crazy maze of terminals.

On this occasion, the transfer was on the simpler side, as both flights used gates in Terminal 2E. That said, I still had to catch the light rail transit from Hall K to Hall L and pass through a full security screening before entering the departures area. Not all airports in Europe require this, and I hope it’s taken into account when CDG simplifies its terminal numbering , which is expected in March 2027.
Thanks to my Flying Blue Gold status , I had access to Air France’s Hall L Lounge, which is currently undergoing some refurbishments.
Getting a post- or pre-flight facial would have been amazing, but, like my five previous visits to Air France’s lounges in Paris, I’ve had no luck at getting a slot.
Either there were simply no slots left, or, as on this visit, the remaining slot(s) were after my departure time.

Speaking of lounges, I took this photo from Air France’s lounge in Terminal 2E, Hall K, on a previous trip. According to a staffer I spoke with, the construction outside will eventually be a huge new flagship Air France lounge for Terminal 2E.

I sent this photo to Ben before I boarded, and he was surprised to see that the board specifically referenced pre-boarding for Flying Blue Ultimate members. In case you didn’t know either, now you do.

Here’s one final pic for the AvGeeks: even though Air France’s version of the A380 wasn’t particularly loved, the elevated jetbridge above the Boeing 777-300ER in this pic was a nostalgic reminder of the airline’s former superjumbos.

If you’re locking in for 10+ hour flight in economy, there’s only a limited level of comfort that any airline would be able to offer. I wasn’t envious at all walking through the premium economy cabin during boarding…

Thanks to my Flying Blue Gold status, I was able to choose any seat in the cabin from 72 hours before departure. Contrary to my avoidance of bulkhead/exit row seats and their fixed armrests on night flights, I picked bulkhead window seat 21L in the front row of the economy cabin.
The legroom here was more than I needed for this day flight. My plan was to spend most of the flight working, so this seat also avoided anyone reclining into my laptop.

Of Air France’s three Airbus A350-900 configurations, this was the newest 292-seater version that has been rolling out since 2023. The economy cabin has 212 seats in a 3-3-3 layout, which I know isn’t usually a favorite of families of four. Non-bulkhead/exit row seats have a pitch of around 31 inches.
I didn’t move the four-way adjustable headrest at all during the flight, and the recline is listed as being around 118 degrees.
No matter where I’m sitting, I can’t help but marvel at that wingtip.

Of the 29 flights I’ve taken with Air France, I can only remember one meal that wasn’t good. In fact, it was terrible, and was actually when I was flying premium economy from Paris to Zanzibar (ZNZ) in 2024.
Of the two meal choices, I went for the chicken pasta (I didn’t note down the second option as I only decided to write about this after the flight).
body_zh: 本着在 OMAAT 尝试新想法和主题的精神，并且了解到你们中的许多人都对阅读有关经济的内容感兴趣，以下是关于法航在这方面的工作表现的一些想法。
我将重点关注从都柏林 (DUB) 经巴黎 (CDG) 返回里约热内卢 (GIG) 的白天返程航班，因为我在出境过夜时尽可能多地睡觉。这不是完整的评论，而是对法航经济舱产品中的座位、食品和技术的一些一般性评论。
完成这次旅行后，我乘坐了法航所有四个舱位级别的航班往返于巴西和法国之间。是的，包括 La Première——我有时确实会飞在尖头。 😉
第一：臭名昭著的戴高乐机场过境经历的一些观察
已经多次经过巴黎戴高乐机场，我实际上已经开始在疯狂的航站楼迷宫中学习如何穿行。
这次的转机比较简单，因为两趟航班都使用 2E 航站楼的登机口。尽管如此，我还是要乘坐轻轨从 K 厅到 L 厅，并通过全面的安检才能进入出发区。并非欧洲所有机场都要求这样做，我希望戴高乐机场在简化其航站楼编号时能够考虑到这一点，预计将于 2027 年 3 月进行。
凭借我的蓝天飞行金卡身份，我可以使用法航的 L 厅休息室，该休息室目前正在进行一些翻新。
在飞行后或飞行前进行面部护理固然很棒，但是，就像我之前五次访问巴黎的法航休息室一样，我没有运气获得一个空位。
要么根本就没有空位，要么就像这次访问一样，剩余的空位在我的出发时间之后。
说到休息室，我在上次旅行时在 2E 航站楼 K 厅的法航休息室拍了这张照片。据我采访的一位工作人员透露，外面的建筑最终将成为 2E 航站楼的一个巨大的新旗舰法航休息室。
我在登机前将这张照片发送给 Ben，他惊讶地发现董事会特别提到了蓝天飞行终极版会员的登机前事宜。如果您也不知道，现在您知道了。
这是 AvGeeks 的最后一张照片：尽管法航版本的 A380 并不是特别受欢迎，但这张照片中波音 777-300ER 上方的高架登机桥让人想起该航空公司以前的超级巨型飞机。
如果您锁定 10 多个小时的经济舱航班，任何航空公司都能提供有限的舒适度。登机时走过豪华经济舱我一点也不羡慕……
凭借我的蓝天飞行金卡会员资格，我可以在出发前 72 小时内选择机舱内的任何座位。与我在夜间航班上避免使用舱壁/出口排座位及其固定扶手相反，我选择了经济舱前排的舱壁靠窗座位 21L。
这里的腿部空间超出了我今天飞行所需的空间。我的计划是在飞行途中大部分时间都在工作，所以这个座位也避免了任何人斜倚在我的笔记本电脑上。
在法航的三种空客 A350-900 配置中，这是自 2023 年以来推出的最新 292 座版本。经济舱有 212 个座位，采用 3-3-3 布局，我知道这通常不是四口之家最喜欢的。非舱壁/出口排座位的间距约为 31 英寸。
在飞行过程中我根本没有移动四向可调头枕，倾斜角度为 118 度左右。
无论我坐在哪里，我都会情不自禁地惊叹于那个翼尖。
在我乘坐的 29 趟法航航班中，我只记得其中一顿饭不好吃。事实上，这很糟糕，而且是 2024 年我从巴黎飞往桑给巴尔 (ZNZ) 的豪华经济舱时的情况。
在两种膳食选择中，我选择了鸡肉意大利面（我没有记下第二个选择，因为我只是决定在飞行后写下这个）。

title_en: Royal Air Maroc Business Class Boeing 737 Review: Good For A Short Hop
title_zh: 摩洛哥皇家航空商务舱波音 737 评测：适合短途飞行
summary: Royal Air Maroc's 737 business class offers spacious seats and a generous meal on the 45-minute Malaga to Casablanca hop, though the cabin is tired and service is cold.
summary_zh: 摩洛哥皇家航空 737 商务舱在 45 分钟的马拉加至卡萨布兰卡航程中提供宽敞的座位和丰盛的餐食，尽管客舱已经很旧了
body_en: To kick off the return portion of our Orient Express adventure via Africa trip , we flew Royal Air Maroc’s Boeing 737-800 business class on the 45-minute flight from Malaga (AGP) to Casablanca (CMN).

I must admit, Royal Air Maroc has a really solid short haul product. While there’s no Wi-Fi or seat back entertainment, I appreciate that the airline has “proper” business class seats, the inflight meal service was outright generous for such a short flight, and I also appreciated the dedicated business class bus upon arrival.

Admittedly the flight attendant serving us didn’t have much personality, and the cabin wasn’t in great condition. But still, those are hardly huge issues. For that matter, it has to be acknowledged how the airlines of northern Africa really lower the bar when it comes to the quality of the inflight experience ( hi, Air Algerie! ), so on a relative basis, this was rather excellent.
How I booked my Royal Air Maroc business class ticket

Ford and I booked an itinerary on Royal Air Maroc all the way from Malaga to Miami via Casablanca. The reason was because the airline offered the best schedule that would get us home the same day after our Orient Express Sailing Yachts cruise .

Royal Air Maroc often makes only one business class seat available, so I had to get a bit creative to make this work. I ended up booking one ticket using 57,500 American AAdvantage miles plus $85.72 in taxes & fees, while the other ticket was booked with cash, at the cost of $1,620, with the following itinerary
10/09 AT989 Malaga to Casablanca departing 2:15PM arriving 1:30PM
10/09 AT204 Casablanca to Miami departing 3:00PM arriving 7:45PM

Obviously paying cash for a ticket wasn’t ideal, but that still ended up being less out of pocket than flying British Airways business class through London on awards, factoring in the carrier surcharges.
Royal Air Maroc business class lounge & boarding

We arrived at Malaga Airport at around 11:30AM, plenty early for our 2:15PM flight. We headed through security and then cleared passport control… only then did I realize that the non-Schengen lounge is currently closed, so we had no lounge option there.

I guess we could’ve exited passport control again to access the lounge in the Schengen area of the terminal , but we figured that wasn’t worth it, so we just decided to grab a seat. I have to say, the non-Schengen portion of the Malaga Airport had quite the scene. Virtually every other flight departing around the same time was on Jet2, and it was definitely a “festive” spirit in the terminal. Based on the passengers, you’d think the airport had banned close-toed shoes.

Boarding for our flight was scheduled for 1:30PM, 45 minutes before departure, from gate B16. Sure enough, that’s exactly when boarding started, with business class passengers being invited to board first.
Royal Air Maroc 737 business class cabin & seats

We boarded the Royal Air Maroc Boeing 737-800 through the forward door, and then turned right into the business class cabin. Royal Air Maroc’s 737s have 12 business class seats, spread across three rows, in a 2-2 configuration.

Royal Air Maroc’s 737 business class seats are particularly spacious, as they boast 43″ of pitch and 21″ of width, with 6″ of recline. So this is significantly more spacious than what you’d find in domestic first class within the United States, where pitch is more commonly around 37-38″ — an extra 5-6″ is definitely noticeable!

These seats have little foot bars that fold down from the seat in front, for extra support while inflight. These were also old style seats, in terms of having large, deep, leather pockets on the seat back.
The tray table folded out from the side of the seat, and had to be flipped over to be fully extended. It was a bit flimsy, as the cabin definitely felt a bit past its prime.
There was a center console where drinks could be placed during the flight, along with additional little drink trays that could be extended, acting as “wings” to the center console.
On the front side of the center console were the AC charging outlets, which were the extent of the charging options there — there were no USB-A or USB-C charging options.
body_zh: 为了开始东方快车非洲之旅的返程部分，我们乘坐摩洛哥皇家航空的波音 737-800 商务舱，从马拉加 (AGP) 飞往卡萨布兰卡 (CMN)，飞行时间为 45 分钟。
我必须承认，摩洛哥皇家航空拥有非常可靠的短途产品。虽然没有 Wi-Fi 或椅背娱乐设施，但我很欣赏该航空公司拥有“合适的”商务舱座位，对于如此短的航班来说，机上餐饮服务非常慷慨，而且我也很欣赏抵达时的专用商务舱巴士。
诚然，为我们服务的空姐没有太多个性，机舱条件也不是很好。但这些仍然算不上什么大问题。就此而言，必须承认北非的航空公司在飞行体验质量方面确实降低了标准（嗨，阿尔及利亚航空！），因此相对而言，这是相当出色的。
我如何预订摩洛哥皇家航空商务舱机票
福特和我预订了摩洛哥皇家航空的行程，从马拉加经卡萨布兰卡飞往迈阿密。原因是航空公司提供了最好的时间表，可以让我们在东方快车航行结束后的同一天回家。
摩洛哥皇家航空通常只提供一个商务舱座位，因此我必须发挥一点创意才能实现这一目标。我最终使用 57,500 美国 AAdvantage 里程加上 85.72 美元的税费预订了一张机票，而另一张机票是用现金预订的，价格为 1,620 美元，行程如下
10/09 AT989 马拉加 飞往 卡萨布兰卡 出发时间 2:15PM 到达 1:30PM
10/09 AT204 卡萨布兰卡 飞往 迈阿密 出发时间 3:00PM 到达 7:45PM
显然，支付现金购买机票并不理想，但考虑到航空公司的附加费，这仍然比通过奖励乘​​坐英国航空商务舱飞往伦敦要省钱。
摩洛哥皇家航空商务舱休息室和登机
我们于上午 11:30 左右抵达马拉加机场，对于我们下午 2:15 的航班来说，时间还早。我们通过安检，然后通过护照检查……直到那时我才意识到非申根休息室目前已关闭，所以我们在那里没有休息室选择。
我想我们可以再次退出护照检查，进入航站楼申根区的休息室，但我们认为这不值得，所以我们决定抢个座位。不得不说，马拉加机场的非申根区也是相当热闹。几乎所有其他大约在同一时间起飞的航班都乘坐 Jet2，航站楼里绝对洋溢着“节日”气氛。根据乘客的情况，你可能会认为机场禁止穿露趾鞋。
我们的航班定于下午 1:30（起飞前 45 分钟）从 B16 登机口登机。果然，登机开始了，商务舱的乘客被邀请先登机。
摩洛哥皇家航空 737 商务舱客舱和座椅
我们从前门登上摩洛哥皇家航空波音737-800，然后右转进入商务舱。摩洛哥皇家航空的 737 飞机有 12 个商务舱座位，分布在三排，采用 2-2 布局。
摩洛哥皇家航空 737 商务舱座椅特别宽敞，间距为 43 英寸，宽度为 21 英寸，倾斜度为 6 英寸。因此，这比美国国内头等舱宽敞得多，美国国内头等舱的间距通常在 37-38 英寸左右，额外的 5-6 英寸间距绝对引人注目！
这些座椅配有小脚杆，可以从前面的座椅向下折叠，在飞行时提供额外支撑。这些也是老式座椅，座椅靠背上有又大又深的皮革口袋。
小桌板从座椅侧面折叠起来，必须翻转才能完全展开。它有点脆弱，因为小屋确实感觉有点过了它的黄金时期。
有一个中控台，可以在飞行过程中放置​​饮料，还有可以延伸的额外小饮料托盘，充当中控台的“翅膀”。
中控台的前侧是交流充电插座，这是充电选项的范围——没有 USB-A 或 USB-C 充电选项。

title_en: Hyatt Credit Cards Compared: Is The Personal Or Business Card Better?
title_zh: 凯悦信用卡比较：个人卡还是商务卡更好？
summary: Chase offers one personal and one business World of Hyatt card. Here's how they compare, and why the personal card is easier to justify, though you can hold both.

body_en: Chase and Hyatt have a pretty straightforward co-brand card portfolio, as there’s one personal card and one business card. Specifically, I’m talking about the World of Hyatt Credit Card and the World of Hyatt Business Credit Card.

In this post, I’d like to compare the two cards, and talk about which is better. First let’s cover the details of both products, and then I’ll share my take on which is worth applying for. This is an especially good time to pick them up, given the current welcome offers.
Link: Learn more about the World of Hyatt Credit Card or World of Hyatt Business Credit Card
The details of Hyatt’s two co-branded credit cards
To start, let’s cover the details of Hyatt’s two co-branded credit cards. Below is a chart with the basics, and I’ll go into a bit more detail below.

Card feature World of Hyatt Card World of Hyatt Business Card Annual fee $95 $199 Elite status Discoverist for as long as you hold the card Discoverist for you plus up to five employees Elite nights (no spend) Five qualifying nights each year None Elite nights from spending Two nights per $5,000 spent, uncapped (one night per $2,500) Five nights per $10,000 spent in a calendar year, uncapped (one night per $2,000) Free night awards One Category 1–4 anniversary night, plus a second after $15,000 spend in a calendar year None Hyatt credits None Up to $100 per anniversary year ($50 back on a $50+ Hyatt purchase, twice) Points rebate None 10% back on redeemed points (up to 20,000/year) once you spend $50,000 in a calendar year Earning on Hyatt stays 4x points 4x points Earning on bonus categories 2x points on restaurants, airline tickets, gyms and fitness clubs, and local transit/commuting 2x points in your top three categories each quarter, from a set list Earning on everything else 1x points 1x points Best for Anyone who stays at Hyatt occasionally; it’s worth keeping for the perks, and it’s the strongest choice for $15K per year in spending Big spenders chasing Hyatt status, and anyone who wants the welcome bonus World of Hyatt Credit Card details
The World of Hyatt Credit Card ( learn more ) is Hyatt’s personal credit card, with a $95 annual fee. Hyatt’s personal credit card offers a variety of perks, including the following
World of Hyatt Discoverist status for as long as you have the card

Five elite qualifying nights every year just for having the card, plus two elite qualifying nights for every $5,000 spent on the card on an ongoing basis; this can help you earn World of Hyatt Explorist status , World of Hyatt Globalist status , and/or other Milestone Rewards
An anniversary free night award valid at a Category 1-4 property, plus a second anniversary free night award when you spend $15,000 on the card in a calendar year

4x points on Hyatt spending, 2x points on restaurants, airline tickets, fitness clubs and gym memberships, and local transit and commuting, and 1x points on all other eligible purchases, with no foreign transaction fees
The World of Hyatt Business Credit Card ( learn more ) is Hyatt’s business credit card, with a $199 annual fee. Hyatt’s business credit card offers many benefits, including the following
World of Hyatt Discoverist status for as long as you have the card, plus the same status for up to five employees
Five elite qualifying nights for every $10,000 spent on the card in a calendar year, with no limit
Up to $100 in Hyatt credits annually, where when you spend $50 or more you’ll receive a $50 statement credit, up to two times; this is based on the anniversary year, and not the calendar year

A 10% rebate on redeemed points, up to 20,000 points per year; you only unlock this if you spend $50,000 on the card in a calendar year, and the benefit applies for the remainder of the calendar year in which you complete the spending
4x points on Hyatt spending, 2x points in your top three spending categories from select options each quarter, and 1x points on all other eligible purchases, with no foreign transaction fees
If you’re considering applying for a Hyatt credit card and would be eligible for a business or personal card, which should you apply for?

The first thing to understand is that the World of Hyatt Card and World of Hyatt Business Card aren’t mutually exclusive. You could apply for both cards, and also earn the welcome bonus on each. So in some ways, it’s worth assessing the value of the cards independently, since you don’t actually have to decide between them.

If you ask me, the World of Hyatt Card is a slam dunk if you stay at Hyatts with any frequency . The card has a reasonable annual fee, and it’s worth holding onto even if you don’t spend a dime on it.

title_en: Amex Blue Business Card Bonus: As High As 50K Points Or $500 Cash Back Welcome Offer
title_zh: Amex Blue 名片奖励：高达 50K 积分或 500 美元现金返还迎新优惠
summary: Amex has boosted welcome offers on the Blue Business Plus (up to 50,000 points) and Blue Business Cash (up to $500), both with no annual fee.
summary_zh: Amex 增加了 Blue Business Plus（最高 50,000 积分）和 Blue Business Cash（最高 500 美元）的迎新优惠，两者均免年费。
body_en: At the moment, we’re seeing increased welcome offers on two of Amex’s most lucrative business cards — The Blue Business® Plus Credit Card from American Express and The American Express Blue Business Cash® Card. Ordinarily these cards have really unremarkable bonuses, but at the moment the offers have been improved very nicely — we’re talking doubled on one card, and more than tripled on the other card. If you don’t yet have either card, this is absolutely the time to apply.

I’ll cover the welcome offer on the Amex Blue Business Plus, which I’d argue is one of Amex’s most lucrative and most approachable business cards, especially for those looking to accrue points. I’ll also talk about the Amex Blue Business Cash, which is essentially the cash back version of the card.
Link: Learn more about The Blue Business® Plus Credit Card from American Express and The American Express Blue Business Cash® Card
What is the current Amex Blue Business Plus welcome offer?

The Amex Blue Business Plus Card bonus is currently as high as 50,000 Membership Rewards points after spending $5,000 on purchases within the first three months of card membership. Apply and find out your welcome offer. Welcome offers vary and you may not be eligible for an offer.

Based on my latest miles & points valuations , Amex Membership Rewards points are worth 1.7 cents each, potentially making this offer worth $850. As a point of comparison, previously the publicly available welcome offer was just 15,000 points after spending $3,000 within the first three months, so this offer is potentially worth more than three times as much. For a no annual fee card ( Rates & Fees ), this is pretty incredible. This is absolutely the time to apply if you’re interested.

However, as I’ll explain below, the reason you get the card isn’t just because of the welcome offer, but also because of the long term value that it offers. There are lots of great uses of Amex Membership Rewards points , as they can be transferred to all kinds of useful airline and hotel partners, ranging from Air Canada Aeroplan, to Air France-KLM Flying Club, to Singapore Airlines KrisFlyer, to Virgin Atlantic Flying Club. Just to give some examples of how points could be redeemed

You could transfer 60,000 points to Flying Blue to book a one-way Air France business class award from Miami (MIA) to Paris (CDG), with $336.90 in taxes & fees; that same flight would cost thousands of dollars if paying cash

You could transfer 60,000 points to Aeroplan to book a one-way SWISS business class award from Boston (BOS) to Zurich (ZRH), with $56.62 in taxes & fees; that same flight would cost thousands of dollars if paying cash
Who is eligible for the Amex Business Plus welcome offer?

In line with Amex’s “once in a lifetime” rule , the Amex Blue Business Plus Card bonus isn’t available to those who currently have the card, or those who have had the card (or previous versions of the card) in the past. On top of that, Amex’s general card restrictions apply. There are a few additional things to note
You are eligible for the Amex Blue Business Plus bonus if you’ve had any other Amex card, so you can apply for this card even if you have another Amex business card

Amex typically has a limit of letting someone have at most five Amex credit cards (including personal and business cards), and this card does count toward that limit, unlike some other Amex business cards
If you’re worried about the Chase 5/24 limit , getting approved for the Amex Blue Business Plus shouldn’t count as a further card toward that limit

Amex does sometimes have application pop-ups indicating that you may not be eligible for a welcome offer even though you meet the published requirements otherwise, and in those cases there’s not much you can do

Anecdotally, I find Amex business cards to generally be among the easiest to get approved for . I also want to emphasize that Amex business cards not counting toward the 5/24 limit really makes the opportunity cost of picking up this card pretty low, for those of us into maximizing our rewards.
Why the Amex Business Plus Card is a no-brainer
The first thing to love about the Amex Blue Business Plus Card is that it has no annual fee ( Rates & Fees )… you can’t beat that!

But really what makes this card unrivaled within the Amex ecosystem is its return on spending, up to a certain limit. Specifically, the Amex Blue Business Plus offers 2x Membership Rewards points on the first $50,000 spent every calendar year, and then 1x points. It’s that straightforward. So $50,000 in spending per year would earn you 100,000 Membership Rewards points.

This is the only no annual fee credit card on the market that earns 2x transferable points that can be moved to the full list of airline and hotel partners at the “premium” ratio. There’s literally not another card like that. The one caveat is that the card does have foreign transaction fees, so I wouldn’t recommend using it for purchases abroad ( Rates & Fees ).

谁有资格获得 Amex Business Plus 迎新优惠？
根据 Amex 的“一生一次”规则，Amex Blue Business Plus 卡奖励不适用于当前持有该卡或过去持有该卡（或该卡的早期版本）的人。最重要的是，美国运通卡的一般限制适用。还有一些额外的事情需要注意
如果您拥有任何其他 Amex 卡，您就有资格获得 Amex Blue Business Plus 奖金，因此即使您拥有其他 Amex 名片卡，您也可以申请此卡
美国运通卡通常有一个限制，允许某人最多拥有五张美国运通信用卡（包括个人卡和名片），与其他一些美国运通名片不同，这张卡确实计入该限制
如果您担心 Chase 5/24 限制，获得 Amex Blue Business Plus 批准不应算作该限制的另一张卡
美国运通有时会弹出申请窗口，表明即使您满足已发布的要求，您也可能没有资格获得欢迎优惠，在这种情况下，您无能为力
有趣的是，我发现美国运通卡通常是最容易获得批准的。我还想强调的是，美国运通卡不计入 5/24 限制，这确实使得拿起这张卡的机会成本相当低，对于我们这些想要最大化奖励的人来说。
为什么美国运通 Business Plus 卡是理所当然的
Amex Blue Business Plus 卡最让人喜爱的一点是它没有年费（费率和费用）……这是您无法比拟的！
但真正让这张卡在美国运通生态系统中无与伦比的是它的消费回报，在一定限度内。具体来说，Amex Blue Business Plus 在每个日历年的前 50,000 美元消费中提供 2 倍会员奖励积分，然后再提供 1 倍积分。就是这么简单。因此，每年 50,000 美元的消费将为您赢得 100,000 点会员奖励积分。
这是市场上唯一一张无需年费的信用卡，可赚取 2 倍可转让积分，这些积分可以按“高级”比例转移到航空公司和酒店合作伙伴的完整列表中。确实没有第二张这样的卡了。需要注意的是，该卡确实有国外交易费用，因此我不建议使用它在国外购物（费率和费用）。

body_en: Selected U.S. Military Contracts for the Week of March 6 - March 10, 2017 user+1@localho… Wed, 03/15/2017 - 01:41 Selected U.S. military contracts for March 6, 2017 U.S. ARMY Blue Storm Associates Inc. , doing business as Pemdas Technologies and Innovation, Alexandria, Virginia, was awarded a $49,500,000 order dependent contract for the Atmospheric Sensing and Prediction System. Bids were solicited via the internet with one received. U.S. Army Contracting Command, Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, is the contracting activity (W911NF-17-D-0001). Selected U.S. military contracts for March 7, 2017 U.S. AIR FORCE Kelly Aviation Center LP , San Antonio, has been awarded a $1,001,978,024 indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract for KC-10 engine contractor logistic support. Contractor will provide engine teardown and overhaul, on-wing support/contract field teams, and engine parts and logistics. In addition, the contractor will provide all support required to fulfill this requirement, including but not limited to labor, materials, tools, equipment, parts, and transportation. Air Force Life Cycle Management Center, Tinker AFB, Oklahoma, is the contracting activity (FA8105-17-D-0002). U.S. NAVY Avian LLC , Lexington Park, Maryland, is being awarded an $11,402,443 cost-plus-fixed-fee contract to provide support for the Naval Air Warfare Center Aircraft Division’s Integrated System Evaluation Experimentation and Test Department (AIR-5.1). Services provided will include flight test engineering, programmatic, administrative, design, execution, analysis, evaluation, and reporting of tests and experiments of aircraft, unmanned air systems, weapons and weapons systems. The Naval Air Warfare Center Aircraft Division, Patuxent River, Maryland, is the contracting activity (N00421-17-C-0049). Selected U.S. military contracts for March 8, 2017 U.S. NAVY Sierra Nevada Corp. , Rancho, California, is being awarded a $30,995,905 modification to a previously awarded firm-fixed-price, cost-plus-fixed-fee, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract (N00174-09-D-0003) to extend the ordering period and exercise Option Year 6 for the procurement and support of the transmitting set, countermeasures AN/PLT-5, to support explosive ordnance disposal personnel. The AN/PLT-5 is a man-portable system in support of the Joint Service Explosive Ordnance Disposal Counter Radio Controlled Improvised Explosive Device Electronic Warfare program. The Naval Surface Warfare Center Indian Head Explosive Ordnance Disposal Technology Division, Indian Head, Maryland, is the contracting activity. Vector Planning and Services Inc. , San Diego, is being awarded a potential $17,910,070 indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity, cost-plus-fixed-fee contract to provide cyberspace science, research, engineering, and technology integration. Support includes innovative technology assessment and development; rapid software development and prototyping; enabling capability training; security engineering; and cybersecurity risk management. This is one of four multiple-award contracts. All awardees will have the opportunity to compete for task orders during the ordering period. The Space and Naval Warfare Systems Center Pacific, San Diego, is the contracting activity (N66001-17-D-0117). Selected U.S. military contracts for March 9, 2017 U.S. MISSILE DEFENSE AGENCY Lockheed Martin Space Systems Co. , Sunnyvale, California, was awarded a $53,052,807 competitive cost-plus-fixed-fee contract for a 36-month period with no options for the Multi-Object Kill Vehicle Technology Risk Reduction (TRR) effort. This contract represents part of the Missile Defense Agency’s technology risk reduction strategy to improve performance and reduce risk for a gimbaled seeker assembly, integrated avionics assembly, component integration and testing, and an advanced seeker. The Missile Defense Agency, Huntsville, Alabama, is the contracting activity (HQ0147-17-C-0002). U.S. NAVY ViON Corp. , Herndon, California, is being awarded a $34,790,000 indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract to provide Capacity as a Service support to Space and Naval Warfare Systems Command (Spawar) Headquarters, Spawar System Center Pacific and Spawar System Center Atlantic. The Capacity as a Service acquisition model allows Spawar to more accurately scale, up and down, its information technology (IT) infrastructure to meet evolving mission requirements. Savings are realized through no up-front costs and a “pay as you go” acquisition model, reducing waste usually associated with overbuying of IT equipment to eventually meet an expectation of mission requirement. Under this contract, ViON is responsible for providing on-demand, on-premise computing, networking and storage solutions for a variety of systems and applications for the command’s research, development, testing and evaluation core infrastructures, laboratory and data center environments. This contract includes options, which if exercised, would bring the maximum contract value to $49,990,000. The Space and Naval Warfare Systems Command, San Diego, is the contracting activity (N00039-17-D-0003). body_en: Autoflight V5000 Matrix william.moore@… Tue, 03/31/2026 - 07:48 The V5000 Matrix is a lift-plus-cruise hybrid-electric/all-electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft being developed by AutoFlight Europe GmbH. Unveiled in February 2026, the aircraft performed a remotely piloted transition from thrustborne hover to wingborne cruise, demonstrating that flight testing is already underway. Industry commentators have suggested that entry into service could be as soon as 2027/2028, although there is no confirmation of this. Certification is to be sought from the Civil Aviation Administration of China (CAAC) under powered-lift regulations. Structure and Powertrain The Matrix pushes regulations to their maximum, being a 10 seat eVTOL with a maximum take-off weight of 5,700kg (hybrid version). The aircraft could be configured in a 6-seat VIP layout, or a 9-seat business layout plus a pilot. It will also feature a lavatory, the first eVTOL design to incorporate this, an indication of its lengthier flight duration capabilities. An uncrewed cargo variant is also in development. The intended market is more regional-focused than previous eVTOL designs. Structurally, the V5000 is an evolution of the previous Autoflight Prosperity I and CarryAll cargo variant. It features a long, aerodynamic cabin with panoramic viewing windows and skid-style landing gear. A main high wing is complemented by two smaller wings to the front and rear of the aircraft, with three booms extending across all three wings parallel to the cabin, on each side. 20 two-blade fixed propellers are mounted to the six booms to provide lift, while eight cruise propellers provide forward thrust, four mounted to the front and four to the rear. body_zh: Autoflight V5000 Matrix william.moore@… 星期二，03/31/2026 - 07:48 V5000 Matrix 是一款由 AutoFlight Europe GmbH 开发的升力加巡航混合电动/全电动垂直起降 (eVTOL) 飞机。该飞机于 2026 年 2 月亮相，进行了从推力悬停到翼载巡航的遥控转换，表明飞行测试已经在进行中。行业评论员表示最快可能于 2027/2028 年投入使用，但尚未证实这一点。根据动力升降机法规，需向中国民用航空局 (CAAC) 申请认证。结构和动力总成 Matrix 将法规发挥到了极致，是一款 10 座电动垂直起降飞机，最大起飞重量为 5,700 公斤（混合动力版本）。该飞机可配置为 6 座 VIP 布局，或 9 座商务布局加一名飞行员。它还将配备卫生间，这是第一个采用此功能的电动垂直起降设计，这表明其具有更长的飞行时间能力。一种无人驾驶的货运版本也在开发中。与之前的 eVTOL 设计相比，目标市场更加注重区域性。从结构上讲，V5000 是之前 Autoflight Prosperity I 和 CarryAll 货运型号的演变。它拥有一个长长的空气动力学客舱，配有全景窗和滑橇式起落架。主高机翼由飞机前部和后部的两个较小机翼进行补充，每侧都有三个吊杆延伸到所有三个机翼，与机舱平行。 6 个吊杆上安装了 20 个两叶固定螺旋桨以提供升力，而 8 个巡航螺旋桨则提供向前推力，其中 4 个安装在前部，4 个安装在后部。规格 飞机类型 升力加巡航 座椅 最多 10 个最大起飞重量 5,700kg/12,500 lbs（混合动力版） 有效载荷 1,500kg/3,300 lbs（混合动力版） 1,000kg/2,200 lbs（电动版） 翼展 20m/66 ft. 起落架滑橇式航程1,500 公里/930 英里（混合动力版） 250 公里/155 英里（电动版） 预计 2027/2028 年投入使用 飞行控制 电传操纵起飞和着陆 VTOL 自主 远程驾驶能力 频道商业航空计划资料 ID 471809
